'''Ultracord''' was a type of [[Rope/Legends|rope]]. It was used to bind offenders who broke the rules at [[Exovar's Emporium]] before they were dumped in the arctic wastelands of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] as punishment.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
